verdict.rationale: Antigravity has a dedicated headless CLI doc page that says the CLI runs non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output. The Python Agent SDK offers a further programmatic automation path. The evidence is a single summary line per source, with no detail on how it works. missing for 10: specifics such as flags, output formats, CI auth/permission handling and exit codes, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.
The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Google Antigravity, programmable in Python.
